needed.evidence: Informal path under 1m and partly blocked by obstacles including market stalls.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, usable pedestrian sidewalk at least 1m wide along the left side of the road.

needed.evidence: Footway obstructed by vendors’ stalls and red umbrellas.
needed.suggestion: Remove or relocate market stalls and any items blocking the right-side footway to allow free passage.

needed.evidence: Uneven and broken surface on the informal path.
needed.suggestion: Resurface and pave the footpath to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: Uneven surface on the informal path.
needed.suggestion: Resurface and level the right-side informal path with durable materials.

needed.evidence: Pedestrians crossing without a designated crossing facility.
needed.suggestion: Install clearly marked pedestrian crossings with raised platforms and kerb ramps at intervals of 100m along the road.
